summary.en: A man using the name Dan Cooper hijacked an airliner on November 24, 1971. His identity and fate remain unconfirmed.
summary.ko: A man using the name Dan Cooper hijacked an airliner on November 24, 1971. His identity and fate remain unconfirmed.

body.en: The FBI public record documents the hijacking, ransom and surviving evidence while leaving the hijacker's identity unresolved.
body.ko: The FBI public record documents the hijacking, ransom and surviving evidence while leaving the hijacker's identity unresolved.

text.en: The FBI announced that it redirected active investigative resources while continuing to accept specific physical evidence.
text.ko: The FBI announced that it redirected active investigative resources while continuing to accept specific physical evidence.

reason.en: The agency statement was checked directly; it is not presented as a complete view of all internal activity.
reason.ko: The agency statement was checked directly; it is not presented as a complete view of all internal activity.

whatItEstablishes.en: The policy the agency announced publicly.
whatItEstablishes.ko: The policy the agency announced publicly.

whatItDoesNotEstablish.en: An identification, Cooper's death, or that no investigation occurred afterward.
whatItDoesNotEstablish.ko: An identification, Cooper's death, or that no investigation occurred afterward.

counterEvidence.en: The FBI's 2007 public request records an earlier period of active investigation; it is a different point in time, not contradictory new evidence.
counterEvidence.ko: The FBI's 2007 public request records an earlier period of active investigation; it is a different point in time, not contradictory new evidence.

changeHistory.en: H-C1: policy change recorded; no identity status change.
changeHistory.ko: H-C1: policy change recorded; no identity status change.

text.en: Richard McCoy has been confirmed as D.B. Cooper.
text.ko: Richard McCoy has been confirmed as D.B. Cooper.

reason.en: The existence of a private claim and an official identification are kept separate; the two positions are not shown as equal evidence.
reason.ko: The existence of a private claim and an official identification are kept separate; the two positions are not shown as equal evidence.

sourceType.en: Primary/closest - official case overview; publication date not stated
sourceType.ko: Primary/closest - official case overview; publication date not stated

whatItEstablishes.en: The agency's public account differs from the private identification claim.
whatItEstablishes.ko: The agency's public account differs from the private identification claim.

whatItDoesNotEstablish.en: That the private claim became a new official identification.
whatItDoesNotEstablish.ko: That the private claim became a new official identification.

counterEvidence.en: The FBI lists reasons for ruling McCoy out, including mismatches with two crew descriptions; the private claim cites similarities and interpretations of objects.
counterEvidence.ko: The FBI lists reasons for ruling McCoy out, including mismatches with two crew descriptions; the private claim cites similarities and interpretations of objects.

changeHistory.en: H-C2: new reporting was recorded, but identity status did not change.
changeHistory.ko: H-C2: new reporting was recorded, but identity status did not change.

text.en: The December 2025 return of a parachute authenticated it as Cooper's parachute.
text.ko: The December 2025 return of a parachute authenticated it as Cooper's parachute.

reason.en: Returning or disposing of an object is separate from authenticating it; absence of authentication is not converted into a fake verdict.
reason.ko: Returning or disposing of an object is separate from authenticating it; absence of authentication is not converted into a fake verdict.

sourceType.en: Secondary reporting; receipt, examination report and agency authentication not found
sourceType.ko: Secondary reporting; receipt, examination report and agency authentication not found

whatItEstablishes.en: The owner described a return without a conclusion, and the report relays the FBI's refusal to comment.
whatItEstablishes.ko: The owner described a return without a conclusion, and the report relays the FBI's refusal to comment.

whatItDoesNotEstablish.en: Authentication, official exclusion, or a direct agency statement that examination was inconclusive.
whatItDoesNotEstablish.ko: Authentication, official exclusion, or a direct agency statement that examination was inconclusive.

counterEvidence.en: The report includes a contrary interpretation and a retired agent's general view; the 2016 FBI policy also does not equate receipt with authentication.
counterEvidence.ko: The report includes a contrary interpretation and a retired agent's general view; the 2016 FBI policy also does not equate receipt with authentication.

changeHistory.en: H-C2: news item added; authentication remains unverified.
changeHistory.ko: H-C2: news item added; authentication remains unverified.

statusQualifier.en: Strong counterevidence - PRIMARY IDENTIFIED, NOT RETRIEVED
statusQualifier.ko: Strong counterevidence - PRIMARY IDENTIFIED, NOT RETRIEVED

text.en: A usable Cooper DNA profile was obtained from the cigarette butts.
text.ko: A usable Cooper DNA profile was obtained from the cigarette butts.

reason.en: Public counterevidence is strong, but the key internal record was not retrieved; neither CONFIRMED DNA nor a fully audited DEBUNKED status is used.
reason.ko: Public counterevidence is strong, but the key internal record was not retrieved; neither CONFIRMED DNA nor a fully audited DEBUNKED status is used.

sourceType.en: Primary identified, not retrieved; internal date not verified
sourceType.ko: Primary identified, not retrieved; internal date not verified

whatItEstablishes.en: There is strong counterevidence to the cigarette-butt DNA claim, while the checked FBI article identifies the tie as the DNA source.
whatItEstablishes.ko: There is strong counterevidence to the cigarette-butt DNA claim, while the checked FBI article identifies the tie as the DNA source.

whatItDoesNotEstablish.en: A review of every internal record, the exact disposal date or process, or the full current sample inventory.
whatItDoesNotEstablish.ko: A review of every internal record, the exact disposal date or process, or the full current sample inventory.

counterEvidence.en: A cited FBI Evidence Review and a former case agent's account indicate the butts were gone before DNA work; initial collection alone does not prove a successful profile.
counterEvidence.ko: A cited FBI Evidence Review and a former case agent's account indicate the butts were gone before DNA work; initial collection alone does not prove a successful profile.

changeHistory.en: Corrected an AI cigarette-butt/tie mix-up; this is not a new forensic finding.
changeHistory.ko: Corrected an AI cigarette-butt/tie mix-up; this is not a new forensic finding.

text.en: DNA recovered from the tie must belong to Cooper.
text.ko: DNA recovered from the tie must belong to Cooper.

reason.en: Evidence connecting the object to the person is required; 'may not be his' is not rewritten as 'is not his.'
reason.ko: Evidence connecting the object to the person is required; 'may not be his' is not rewritten as 'is not his.'

sourceType.en: Primary - agency statement; raw analysis and complete custody history not obtained
sourceType.ko: Primary - agency statement; raw analysis and complete custody history not obtained

whatItEstablishes.en: The agency described DNA derived from the tie.
whatItEstablishes.ko: The agency described DNA derived from the tie.

whatItDoesNotEstablish.en: That the person who left the DNA was necessarily the hijacker.
whatItDoesNotEstablish.ko: That the person who left the DNA was necessarily the hijacker.

counterEvidence.en: A former agent discussed handling, contact routes and multiple contributors; that does not identify another donor either.
counterEvidence.ko: A former agent discussed handling, contact routes and multiple contributors; that does not identify another donor either.

changeHistory.en: No new donor identification was verified in scope.
changeHistory.ko: No new donor identification was verified in scope.
